examples.explanation: Right of 5 sit the smaller values 2 and 1; right of 2 sits 1; right of 6 sits 1; right of 1 sits nothing.
A lone element has nothing to its right.
Neither entry is strictly smaller than the other.

hints: Scanning from right to left turns the task into counting previously seen values below a threshold.
Compress the values to ranks and keep a Fenwick tree of seen frequencies for O(log n) queries and updates.
A merge-sort variant that counts right-side takeovers while merging works too.
title: 404. Count of Smaller Numbers After Self
